title: University of Colorado Boulder
description: CU Boulder's official visual identity guidelines define the primary palette CU Gold (#CFB87C), Black (#000000), CU Dark Gray (#565A5C) and CU Light Gray (#A2A4A3), and the secondary palette Accessible CU Gold (#8D7334), CUB Sky Blue (#096FAE), CUB Light Gold (#F3F0E9), CUB Dark Blue (#0A3758) and CUB Light Blue (#EEF5F8).
